notes:
Shorthand notes from discovery and follow-ups:
- Lead: Ravi Patel (CTO) / small engineering org (50-70 engs). Focus: automate triage + summarization for inbound support email + chat.
- Primary ask: hosted API (self-serve) that returns strict JSON (ticket fields) PLUS ability to call internal tools (tool-calling) to attach metadata (customer SLA, account tier).
- Quote: "We need JSON-first outputs we can ingest straight into our queue; summaries must be <800ms 95p or we lose agent flow."
- Cost sensitivity: SMB; wants predictable low-cost per-summary. Estimates they will run ~60-120k summarization calls/month in steady state.
- Security: require SSO (SAML) for team console, audit logs for any data access, and retention controls (30/90 day options). Data residency not a blocker initially (US region okay).
- Integration notes: uses Postgres-backed ticket store, webhooks to push structured ticket object, plans to use function-calls to enrich tickets with internal account metadata.
- POC ask: sample prompt set for 5 ticket archetypes, example of structured output schema (json schema), quick latency bench (p50/p95) for small summary length (~100 tokens).
- Sales angle: self-serve first; if volume increases will consider Dedicated reserved capacity. Mentioned competitors in use at customers: Zendesk + Intercom; QuickWeave sells add-on automation layer.
- Internal risk: SOC wants retention + audit docs before sharing sample production data. Also need clear per-token vs per-call pricing for summaries.
- Next: send POC keys (hosted API), quickstart snippet for tool-calling, provide one-sheet on retention/audit, link to security FAQ (done).
- Follow-up owner: Avery Chen. SE follow-up: Marco Ruiz to produce sample prompt pack by 2026-03-14.
